newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daewoo Motor March sales up 13.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daewoo Motor March sales up 13.5 percent.

text.p: Daewoo Motor Co Ltd, an unlisted affiliate of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Wednesday its vehicle sales in March rose 13.5 percent to 61,899 units from 54,522 a year earlier.
A Daewoo statement said exports rose 11.4 percent to 34,380 units in March from 30,873 units a year before.
Daewoo's domestic vehicle sales increased 16.4 percent to 27,519 units from 23,649 units.
A Daewoo spokesman said the sales rise was due to the successful debut of two new model cars.
Sales of Nubira compact cars, which began selling in February, totalled 11,723 units in March, and smaller Lanos cars, which rolled out from November 1996, amounted to 4,662.
